title: SECURITY DEFINER helper that takes a user id is a membership oracle (correctness)
issue: A SECURITY DEFINER helper skips RLS and trusts its p_user argument; EXECUTE is granted to PUBLIC by default, so any API user can ask about any other user.
symptom: oracle_app_helper returns the number of OTHER users' memberships the caller can discover (correct: 0).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.docs (10 orgs; user N is a member of org N only)

subjects.name: user1
subjects.note: member of org 1; users 2..10 are other tenants
